skill.name: audio-producer
skill.description: Expert in web audio, audio processing, and interactive sound design

generated_query: I’m designing a website for a virtual art gallery and want to add an interactive audio experience. Each artwork should have its own ambient soundscape that plays when the visitor clicks on it, with spatial audio that makes the sound appear to come from the direction of the artwork on the screen. I also need subtle reverb and delay effects on the sounds to match the gallery atmosphere. Additionally, I’d like a background music player that automatically fades between tracks as the user moves between rooms, with custom playback controls (play/pause, volume slider, progress bar) and a waveform visualization of the current track. Can you help me build these interactive audio components using React?
